name: Harpy Matriarch
generous: Harpies need to have heroes separated enough to attack effectively.
deadly: Lure heroes off a cliff >:D

name: Storm Giant
generous: Storm Giants may not deal lethal Wounds to an honorable heroes who yield to them as supreme.
deadly: Thunder Stride whenever you can damage 3 or more heroes with it to make them split up. Use Lightning Spear on low HP heroes since it will still deal some damage even if Interposed.

name: Sage (Priest)
generous: Go last in a round, so heroes can take out the blessed ally before they can attack.
deadly: Go first in a round, bless lower HP allies.

name: Knight
generous: Interpose for lower damage allies, especially vs crits that ignore your heavy armor.
deadly: Interpose for stronger allies, especially vs attacks with modifiers that your Heavy armor can easily mitigate.

name: Knight Dragoon
generous: Stay close to heroes so that Lance has a lesser effect.
deadly: Hit and run. Charge in to attack then move away to build up another big Lance attack.

name: Doppelganger
generous: Use Shapeshifter only on weak attacks, or not at all.
deadly: Hold Shapeshifter and make heroes wary to attack—save it for a big hit and swap with a flimsy hero.

name: Spy
generous: Fight only long enough to flee! Spies don't want to kill, they want to escape notice.
deadly: Poison as many targets as you can, keep out of the melee.

name: Assassin
generous: Spread around your initial attack, and withdraw if ambushing doesn't kill your targets.
deadly: Take out a healer or other weak target down in your first strike. Bunch up to auto-crit on Distracted targets.

name: Rakshasa
generous: Teleport Ranged heroes away or nearer to their allies.
deadly: Separate heroes, or teleport them into traps, pits, or cages.

name: Red Dragon
generous: Dragons shouldn't be easy (but you could take an additional turn in the air "breathing in" and you can telegraph the area you'll be targeting).
deadly: Take out your own whelps to enable Burninate! Combo Tail or Landing with Crush for big damage.

name: Roaring Blaze
deadly: Weaker elementals attack first to set up Searing Strikes for stronger elementals. Weaker ones can attack allied elementals to boost their power for a turn.

name: Raging Inferno
generous: Stronger elementals attack first, wasting powerful Searing Strikes.
deadly: Weaker elementals attack first to set up Searing Strikes for stronger elementals. Weaker ones can attack allied elementals to boost their power for a turn.

name: Firelord Blackflame
generous: Minimize the heroes in your Incinerate cone. Have his summoned creatures attacks creatures not yet damaged by fire. Keep him safely away from heroes, use his summons to protect him.
deadly: Incinerate all heroes once each round, and rely on the summons to deal most of the damage. Let him soak up damage so he can summon more enemies too soon. Include fire elementals in the Incinerate to boost their damage.

name: Brimstone Blasthand
generous: Start combat needing to reload
deadly: start combat loaded and ready to Fire!

name: Brimstone Whipmaster
generous: Use Obey! on allies that are already low on HP.
deadly: Move the heroes into clumps to set up big AoE attacks from Blasthands. And whip Blasthands to make them reload faster.

name: Brimstone Scorchsmith
generous: Place allies adjacent to be damaged by Flame Forged.
deadly: Combine with a Blackguard to protect allies from their damage. Whip them for tremendous fire damage when surrounded by heroes.

name: Cinderbelcher
generous: The fire elemental trapped within sees the heroes as its ally against the Dwarves.
deadly: The fire elemental attacks the heroes.

name: Iron Goat
generous: Knock heroes straight back and chase them down.
deadly: Knock heroes off cliffs or into rocks for extra forced movement damage. Make them climb back up to reach you, then do it again!

name: Young Remorhaz
generous: Focus on grappling, only Swallow when nearing death.
deadly: Move often to apply Living Blast Furnace to all heroes each round. Swallow creatures who can easily ignore your armor anyway.

name: Abominable Yeti
generous: Use Dreadful Eye against close-range targets.
deadly: Lock back heroes with big melee dice using Dreadful Eye. Punish Cheats and other crit-fishing heroes with Limb from Limb.

name: Iskaryth The Frostborne
generous: Iskareth can say "YOU ALL WILL BE BITTEN BY FROST!" and spend a few turns flying with Biting each hero "WHO'S NEXT?", greatly reducing her damage output (and allowing the heroes to RP and try to deceive her or heal through the Frostbite and catch up). Return to the normal tactics when you feel the heroes have regained the upper hand.
deadly: Regain Blizzard once when Dying and increase the DC to 16 (or they must deal 16 Bludgeoning or Fire damage). Instead of a straight line, you can use Wall of Ice to completely encircle a hero!

name: Hookspawn
generous: Target Ranged heroes who have little need to move.
deadly: Lacerate as many heroes as possible. Combine with Glabrezu, Hezrou, or Incubus/Succubus to force movement.

name: Incubus/Succubus
generous: Target strong-willed heroes (Shepherd & Songweaver)
deadly: Target weak-willed heroes (The Cheat & Shadowmancer)

name: Vrock
generous: Keep it near strong melee heroes (Berserker, Commander, Oathsworn) so the save is much easier to overcome.
deadly: Keep it in the air out of melee reach, target weaker heroes (Mage, Songweaver, Stormshifter).

name: Hezrou
generous: Move twice instead of one of your attacks. Target high-STR/DEX classes to be consumed.
deadly: Target classes that buff their allies (e.g., Commander, Songweaver) to limit their special abilities.

name: Glabrezu
generous: Target two different heroes with Doomclaw.
deadly: Target a single weak/slow hero with both Doomclaws.

name: Nalfeshnee
generous: Cast copies of weaker spells, stay near melee heroes.
deadly: Use your mobility to stay far away from heroes.

name: Hierarch
generous: Act last amongst monsters or Offer Absolution to those not at risk of being attacked.
deadly: Act first and Offer Absolution to those at greatest risk of being attacked.

name: Overlord
generous: Have all minions Offer to Taunt a single nearby enemy who can easily dispatch them with an AoE.
deadly: Each minion Offers to Taunt a different enemy, continue to target any Hero who rejects. Extra challenging when combined with the Lumbrax, Pactmonger, or Hierarch.

name: Executor
generous: Allow the heroes to creatively coordinate their choices in secret (e.g., telepathy or stealth check).
deadly: If the Executor notices coordination, heroes may forfeit their choice and you choose for them this round instead.

name: Quasit
generous: When damaged, it can make its Offer, if accepted it can flee combat in a puff of sulfuric smoke.
deadly: Tempt multiple heroes with smaller weapons to make Opportunity Attacks by moving past them or moving away after attacking. It can OFFER more riches, but they only carry enough gp to fulfil the offer once—"I'll owe you! hehehehe…"

name: Grumbulus
generous: Make your Offer more often (e.g., when you take damage), or select a powerful Fiend instead of choosing randomly.
deadly: Use these with other powerful Fiends to really tempt Heroes into taking the offer—or with ones that summon weak minions like the Lumbrax to increase the chances of the heroes getting a bad deal!

name: Pactmonger
generous: Choose strong heroes, ones that can easily be protected, or ones that have already accepted an offer.
deadly: Act last amongst monsters. Choose heroes with very low HP, they'll lose the action anyway when they drop to 0!

name: Lumbrax
generous: Swarm your minions around Heroes who can easily deal AoE damage. The minions are lazy and attack next round.
deadly: Threaten weakened heroes with BIG damage (feel free to let them know you'll be rolling d20s!) so you can summon LOTS of minions (who attack right away). Works great with the Grumbulus.

name: Justiciar
generous: Limit the need to Interpose by spreading damage out and attacking more well-armored heroes.
deadly: Focus-fire weak heroes, force their allies to Interpose. Tempt them into making Opportunity Attacks against weak enemies. Use Cruel Judgment to to set up devastating Offerings for the Hierarch, Lashfiend, or Pactmonger.

name: Lashfiend
generous: Target strong heroes (Berserker, Commander, Oathsworn)
deadly: Target weak heroes (Mage, Songweaver, Stormshifer)

name: Cloud Giant
generous: Move an ally that has already attacked, or a ranged hero. Wait to attack with cyclone minions until the next round.
deadly: Throw heroes out a window, off a ledge, or into range for a big AoE with Pawn in My Domain. Or boost an ally, moving them into a critical backline position for a powerful attack.

name: Naga Skeleton
generous: Remind heroes that they can choose to fail a save!

name: Naga Warden
generous: Prioritize heroes who go later in the round or allow heroes to take their turns in a different order.
deadly: Prioritize heroes that go earlier in the round. Charm melee heroes to make them spend actions moving back into reach with you.

name: Wererat
generous: Avoid using Bite. Instead, turn your focus to the heroes still standing. Skitter to areas within Range of heroes.
deadly: Focus on weak heroes and use Bite at every opportunity. Skitter to block movement of enemies.

name: Werewolf
generous: Attack enemies far away from your allies.
deadly: Maximize use of Pack Hunter: charge a Wereboar in first, then bring in the Werewolves.

name: Wereboar
generous: Attack the nearest creatures, limiting Charge damage.
deadly: Maximize your use of Charge

name: Werebear
generous: Use the Knockback of Maul to turn off the Werewolves' Pack Hunter ability. Maul 2 different targets rather than attacking a Prone one.
deadly: Knock heroes into their own allies, or knockback to increase Wereboar's Charge damage or adjacent to allied Werewolves, giving them Advantage 2 (Prone + Pack Hunter).
